name: The Valor Family
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I would appreciate bringing it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
narrative.objectives: Search Raven Hill for anything of interest and return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
narrative.offerRewardText: This tome appears to be about the Valor family. I believe I've heard of a few of them. Good folk. Not sure they merit an entire book about them.I'll make you a copy of the tome. If you see anything else related to them on your travels, I'll be happy to take it off your hands.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.
